# spawn-doors.txt — every tracked cell (outside tests/) that calls a host native which starts a child:
# host_spawn host_spawn_quiet host_spawn_at host_capture host-exec. One row per file: path | class | why.
# Read by form-stdlib/tests/spawn-guard-band.bml, which computes the same set from `git ls-files` and refuses a file that
# is missing here, a row whose file is gone or no longer calls one, and a guarded row whose file does not ask spawn-guard.
#
#   guarded  the file imports form-stdlib/bml/spawn-guard.bml and asks it before a command another cell or an agent supplied is begun
#   organ    the guard itself (spawn-guard.bml): its sg- wrappers ask, then begin the child
#   table    the control language's door table: reached only through ftv-door in form-token-verbs.bml, which asks
#   fixed    every command the file starts is words written in the file (./fkwu cells, OS tools, git); no caller supplies a tool
#   seed     the one bootstrap crossing: the C compiler on the committed seed or the carrier source
#   rented   a third-party program the body does not yet carry natively: the smallest next step is named in the row
#
form/form-stdlib/bml/abstraction-flow.bml | fixed | ./fkwu job cell
form/form-stdlib/bml/bml-form-lower.bml | fixed | ./fkwu on a source file
form/form-stdlib/bml/form-token-verbs.bml | guarded | ftv-door asks sg-door-forbidden before any door runs
form/form-stdlib/bml/form-token-workspace.bml | table | the door table and its fixed ./fkwu and kill children; asked at ftv-door
form/form-stdlib/bml/host-child.bml | guarded | hch-run-with asks sg-argv-reason, hch-read is sg-capture
form/form-stdlib/bml/spawn-guard.bml | organ | sg-spawn-at, sg-spawn-quiet, sg-spawn, sg-capture and sg-exec ask, then call the native
form/form-stdlib/form-glass-bootstrap.fk | fixed | runs before core admission; its argv is ./fkwu cells and the seed's own checks
form/form-stdlib/land-cadence-live.fk | fixed | the lens commands of land-cadence.fk's table
form/form-stdlib/lane-motion.bml | fixed | git
form/form-stdlib/lora-voice.bml | fixed | git
form/form-stdlib/metal-carrier.bml | seed | /usr/bin/cc on form/native/metal/fk-metal-carrier.m
form/form-stdlib/native-lora-fuse.bml | fixed | ./fkwu cell
form/form-stdlib/native-lora-worker.bml | fixed | the worker's ./fkwu cells
form/form-stdlib/native-session-learning.bml | fixed | ./fkwu cell
form/form-stdlib/native-session-memory.bml | fixed | ./fkwu cell
form/form-stdlib/native-session-sources.bml | fixed | git worktree list
form/form-stdlib/symbol-voice.bml | fixed | grep over the corpus
form/form-stdlib/voice-say.bml | rented | Piper and its python phonemizer: a native phonemizer is the next step
form/form-stdlib/voice-school.bml | fixed | git
gate/drift-gates.bml | fixed | git by argv (the moved paths) and cc on the seed by argv; every gate row is a cell_run, no child
gate/lens-text.bml | fixed | lx-sh, the shell door; no cell of the body is run through it (cell_run answers a cell's value in process)
learn/bml-execution-practice.bml | fixed | ./fkwu cell
observe/band-truth-run.bml | fixed | git ls-files
observe/belief-stamps.bml | fixed | git
observe/ear-glass-live.fk | fixed | ./fkwu ear cells by argv
observe/form-glass-ear-live.fk | fixed | ./fkwu ear cell
observe/form-glass-sensors-live.fk | fixed | ./fkwu sensor cell
observe/form-glass-supervisor-run.fk | fixed | ./fkwu glass cells
observe/native-turn-run.bml | fixed | the native code lane (observe/form-cli-code-run.fk), a model session that holds the one Metal client: a service the walk waits on and ends by pid (the band is cell_run)
observe/prelude-reach.bml | fixed | git
observe/voice-admission-run.bml | fixed | ./fkwu cell
